I never set about finding something practical; rather, like so much I encounter in life and work each day. This particular day unfolded like a familiar pattern – routine meetings to discuss progress, updates with clients to maintain relationships – the usual array designed for a steady hand at an ongoing ship's wheel, but not often with new insights emerging. And so, when I was waiting for an appointment to be finished with, my phone beep with notification. Curiosity pricks me, not unlike the itch to peek under the bed to see that monster really there – there was an e-news from an organization, something about how small acts can ripple, how even a single drop in still pond could send waves.

As usual, such notifications often seem too simplistic to be worthwhile. Yet I found my gaze lingering as usual over each sentence before my finger pressed the read more option
